lessons.lesson: A landing chain joined with ';' let a HOLD pass; gate on the literal ACTIVE_OBSERVATION_PASS string
lessons.applied: all later chains

lessons.lesson: Workers sharing one scratch directory overwrite each other
lessons.applied: per-worker scratch directories in every packet

lessons.lesson: jj restore --from <commit> <dir> deletes files absent from that commit
lessons.applied: per-file restores only

lessons.lesson: An independent reviewer that can reject is worth more than one that only approves; both rejections corrected a real ordering error
lessons.applied: reviewer told explicitly to disagree; second-round re-verification when bytes change

lessons.lesson: Mermaid chained arrows and parenthesised labels fail diagram-check
lessons.applied: one edge per line; diagram-check in the per-wave gate

lessons.lesson: Leases shorter than the integrator's session expire silently; a whole set of same-worker attempts then needs a reclaim set, and a boilerplate portfolio ties them all at an inherited score
lessons.applied: 3h leases sized to intent; checker gains a reviewed reclaim-set mode; residual re-assessment of sibling records against landed evidence before any review

lessons.lesson: Editing the checker after re-hashing the portfolio invalidates the portfolio's own evidence row for the checker file
lessons.applied: rehash last, immediately before the preflight; review bytes regenerated and re-approved

lessons.lesson: Two generated documents were first named with guessed future timestamps (0740, 0825) while the host UTC clock read 06:39; prefixes must come from date -u at write time, never from a sense of elapsed work
lessons.applied: renamed to the observed mtimes 0639 and 0640; every prefix in this session is now taken from the host clock immediately before the Write

lessons.lesson: A service-level test needs the Sa-plan fence (plan, executing task, bridge mapping and lease); preparing it belongs in an OCaml fixture against the Store API, not in Python or ad-hoc SQL
lessons.applied: engines/hermes/modules/sa_plan/test/verify_fence_fixture.exe, invoked through development.bounded by the Gleam test

lessons.lesson: gleam format reflows a one-line condition into several lines, so a mutant pattern copied from the pre-format source silently does not match
lessons.applied: mutant patterns are taken from the formatted file; PATTERN NOT FOUND is treated as not planted, never as killed

lessons.lesson: The Telegram store transport and the Sa-plan frame transport are different workers behind one guardian; an action profile that points the store worker at a Sa-plan database answers unknown_command
lessons.applied: service verify test uses sa_plan_cancel_worker.exe for the profile transport; recorded in the wave 6b journal section 9

lessons.lesson: An independent reviewer with the full diff found that the guardian ran outside any Sa-plan claim; the author tests had normalised it
lessons.applied: claim before exec and complete after are now laws with tests; every signed-approval change gets an R2 review before landing while R5 sessions are stale

lessons.lesson: A mutant that falls through to the same arm it replaced is equivalent and proves nothing; design mutants that change an observable the law asserts
lessons.applied: the vision-fixture mutant was replaced by one that derives amber_led from the byte count; the equivalent one is not counted

lessons.lesson: A bound that outputs cannot reveal (every signature sits inside the first 12 bytes) needs its own observation accessor and a law over it
lessons.applied: telegram_media_inspect exposes examined_prefix; the bound-ignored mutant dies only on that law

lessons.lesson: The OCaml-or-Mojo mandate covers helper scripts and fixtures; sed -i applying one literal edit is a host utility, Python, awk and perl one-liners remain barred
lessons.applied: answered worker w1 in the journal; the shared worker packet states it

lessons.lesson: Author tests of a store exercised only complete writes; the independent reviewer found the majors by enumerating interrupted, aged and half-present objects
lessons.applied: every module that writes to disk or executes gets an R2 review before the wave closes; the review prompt asks for crash, race and expiry cases by name

lessons.lesson: Completing Sa-plan tasks after a landing invalidates the risk portfolio records that still declare them executing; the next landing gate holds on RP-SA-PLAN
lessons.applied: complete6*.sh now ends by aligning the portfolio task_state with Sa-plan, re-stamping and rehashing

lessons.lesson: A design safety requirement is a deliverable, not a limit to document; a packet that scopes below it must say so as a gap with its own task
lessons.applied: MEDIA_RECLAIM opened as a task with dependency MEDIA_FIX; the wiki guide and skill now describe the full lifecycle

lessons.lesson: Running gleam format on a shared file that was never formatter-clean rewrites the whole file and hides the increment; format only new files and read jj diff --stat before trusting a build
lessons.applied: the two service files were restored from main and the six edits reapplied by hand; the landing diff is 217 lines

lessons.lesson: Fixture-backed HTTP tests fail under a bare erl eunit call because hackney is not started there; the gleam test runner starts it
lessons.applied: fable-mut-h.sh starts hackney before eunit; the nine baseline slice1 failures under erl are explained, not real

lessons.lesson: A gate added at one dispatch entry is not a gate: the media precedence lived only in RegularDispatch while specialized_dispatch re-read the same row and ran its arms; the author e2e used a caption that never reached them
lessons.applied: the media gate now sits where the row is decoded, before any arm is chosen, and the e2e drives captions that classify to the specialised arms; every surface with more than one entry gets a test per entry

lessons.lesson: When a closed enumeration is introduced, land its completeness law in the same wave. A grep is an enumeration with an assumption baked in: the 6l pattern assumed snake-case codes and missed four literals (one identifier used by the span wrapper and three prose reasons), all of which rendered as unavailable_unspecified.
lessons.applied: mini_reason_code_completeness_test reads the module sources and refuses the next unlisted literal, with a floor of ten literals so an empty scan cannot pass vacuously; the three prose reasons became codes rather than list members

lessons.lesson: A capability injected at start is retained for the process lifetime. The drain took its Send at start so a supervisor could rebuild it, and any Send that closed over a bot token kept the token on the actor heap behind a header that said the opposite; the lexical secrecy tests over reports could not see it.
lessons.applied: Send is passed with every Tick and dropped when the tick ends; the law inspects sys:get_state for a sentinel the Send captured, before and after a tick

lessons.lesson: Two R4 workers on disjoint file sets, briefed with an explicit file list and an explicit no-formatter rule for the one shared never-formatted file, integrated eleven files in one wave with no conflict; the file list in the brief is the isolation mechanism and per-file restore from the snapshotted worker commit is the merge.
lessons.applied: worker briefs name the files they may touch and the ones they may not, forbid gleam format on files they did not create, and ask for FROM/TO mutant records so the integrator can re-run any of them

lessons.lesson: A preflight whose status is printed but not gated is decoration: TELEGRAM_RESIDUALS was claimed while the preflight read HOLD (the portfolio declared two dependencies, Sa-plan held one). HOLD is repaired, never forced, and the claim must wait for it.
lessons.applied: claim.sh runs the preflight, refuses any status but PREFLIGHT_PASS, claims, flips the record, rehashes and requires ACTIVE_OBSERVATION_PASS before returning; the land gate already refused to land on HOLD

lessons.lesson: A fast micro-wave loop between an author and its own advisory subagents inflates test counts while deferring sovereign review, end-to-end service assembly and human operational testing; the KPI that exposes it is staged runtime closure, which reads 0/80 today.
lessons.applied: independent reviews dispatched to AGY as agents under their own worker ids; the next wave wires the staged service (transport bound in the operational configuration, a drain start site) and the ledger carries TG-KPI-09 and TG-KPI-10

lessons.lesson: A capability described as for a deployment to bind is a claim until the tree holds one deployment-shaped caller that binds it under test; configure_media had existed since wave 6i with no caller, and the packets and a resolved forecast both treated the binding as someone else's step.
lessons.applied: the worker runner binds media_root through configure_media_http and the e2e proves the bound path through the supervised runner; TG-KPI-09 counts only flows that run through that node

lessons.lesson: A vault is a claim until a second process reads back what the first one wrote and a wrong key is refused: rusty_vault_nif on nas-1 passes neither test. The durable store that replaced it keeps the vault name space so the migration is a rename.
lessons.applied: uos_vault_file and tools/uos_vault.ml with four laws (round trip from disk, wrong passphrase refused on the MAC, tampered byte refused, 0600 and magic); the staging token is sealed there; the NIF finding is reported for sovereign review

lessons.lesson: An independent reviewer preflights from a workspace at main, so any portfolio record that exists only in the author working copy reads as drift and holds the reviewer; three AGY runs were lost to this.
lessons.applied: land the portfolio before launching a reviewer and freeze it from launch until the claim; the chain script readies the next review only from landed state

lessons.lesson: Adding a ready record to the portfolio while a reviewer is preflighting creates a score tie that holds both the reviewer and the author (RP-SENSITIVITY); and a review that completes in Sa-plan must be mirrored into the portfolio before the next claim or the checker reads drift.
lessons.applied: author records are created blocked and readied only when no reviewer is between launch and claim; completions by other claimants are mirrored at the next alignment

lessons.lesson: Before ingesting from an external tree, ask the VCS whether the artifact is already tracked (jj file list -r main | grep): the vault crate and its dependency had been ingested the day before with better redactions, and the fresh copy duplicated them and would have re-imported the PEM test fixtures.
lessons.applied: ingestion scripts start with a tracked-path check; the duplicate copies were removed before landing and the manifest records the verification instead of a second copy

lessons.lesson: Under set -o pipefail a secret scan that finds nothing (grep exit 1) aborts the script before the manifest is written, so a clean scan looked like a failed ingestion twice.
lessons.applied: the scan is wrapped so no-match is the success path and the hit count is still recorded

lessons.lesson: A record kept ready while its true blocker is a human or operator input makes the checker hold every other claim behind it (RP-SELECTION); readiness must say blocked with the blocker named, which is also the honest state.
lessons.applied: TELEGRAM_E2E carries its blocker (staging token not supplied); readiness is flipped to ready the moment the token arrives

lessons.lesson: rustler NIF arguments typed String decode from Erlang binaries, not charlists, and rustler atoms cannot be created in a cargo test outside a BEAM (unreachable_unchecked abort); laws on the resource type stay in Rust, laws on the atoms go through eunit against the loaded library.
lessons.applied: vf01_laws test the handle; rusty_vault_persistence_test.erl tests the atoms; the BEAM script passes binaries

lessons.lesson: The risk portfolio is read under a 1 MiB bound and must hold a record for every task of its plan, so a plan of about 95 tasks is full; cloning a record to create a new one also copies another task's rationale into it.
lessons.applied: the four records created today were rewritten with their own content; the next Telegram tasks open a new Sa-plan plan with a fresh portfolio instead of growing this one
